q: What should a one-page methodology note sent to buyers include?
title: Methodology note for buyers
short: The boundary, the period, the scopes covered, the data sources, the factors and their versions, and what was estimated. One page is enough. It lets a buyer understand your figure without a call, and it keeps your answers the same from one buyer to the next.
audience: Exporters and suppliers sharing carbon data

ol: Emission factors with source and version.
Estimates and how they were made.

p: Update it each year and date it, so a buyer knows which version applies.

senseible: Senseible keeps every bill, invoice and calculation in one dated, fingerprinted record, so the evidence behind each figure can be found again by anyone who checks it.
